Cost of living comparison

Compare monthly costs between two cities and find the salary that keeps your savings the same.

What you enter

  • Current city
  • New city
  • Monthly take-home pay in current city
  • Monthly costs in each city

How this is calculated

  • Pay needed for the same savings = current pay + (new city costs − current city costs).
  • Pay scaled by cost ratio = current pay × (new city costs ÷ current city costs).
